feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 21 October 2026 12:00pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 21 October 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds, risk of gales at first.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland and a shallow low moving northwards over Scotland, bringing unsettled conditions and frontal systems across the area.


##Wind##

West or northwest 6 or 7, perhaps increasing gale 8 for a time. Then gradually decreasing 5 or 6 this evening, then 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate, then slight later.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, clearing to isolated showers this evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, backing south or southeast 3 or 4, then becoming east 5 or 6 occasionally 7 in the south of the area overnight into Friday. Then north or northwest 7 or gale 8 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate, then moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Fair, then outbreaks of rain overnight into Friday, heavy at times.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor in rain later.
